title: DHIS2 Tracked Entity Header
description: A banner for one tracked entity, such as a person or a shipment: what it is and the facts that matter most, composed from attribute parts.
docs: Wrap a banner in TrackedEntityHeaderProvider with a trackedEntity and, usually, a program; it loads the tracked entity and the program's attribute metadata once for every part inside. TrackedEntityBanner with no children shows the program's list attributes, its state tags and a details disclosure for the rest. To compose a banner, place the parts TrackedEntityName, TrackedEntityDate, TrackedEntityAttribute, TrackedEntityStatus, TrackedEntityOwner, TrackedEntityEnrollment, TrackedEntityFacts, TrackedEntityActions and TrackedEntityDetails inside it, and place TrackedEntityStatus yourself so an inactive record is never shown by colour alone. Event facts such as a latest reading come from ObservationInline in observation-cards, inside an ObservationsProvider. Every part works outside the banner under the provider; read status and retry from useTrackedEntityHeader to draw the loading, failed, restricted and not-found states yourself. A restricted record shows no values. See the tracked entity header docs page for examples.
